pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown polygonal regions with irregular geometry. Patches are larger and more elongated on the neck and shoulder, becoming smaller and more densely clustered on the posterior. Edge gradients appear smooth and diffuse at the current pixel resolution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored interstitial network forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, tapering from the shoulder toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane is visible along the dorsal neck, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural depression is present in the dorsal line at the cervicothoracic junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small exogenous avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) are perched on the posterior dorsal ridge.
